about: Captain radio chatter (RadioChatter). Two voices per personality: slot 0 and slot 1 (Captain.voice). Files: assets/audio/voice/radio/<personality>_<slot>/<event>_<n>.mp3, made by tools/gen_radio_lines.py. Changing a line: regenerate its two files.

launch_mining: Heading out. Rocks won't mine themselves.
on_site: At the rocks. Starting the cut.
under_fire: They're shooting at me. Big mistake.
fleeing: Too hot even for me. Falling back!
repairs: Hull's chewed up. Coming in for repairs.
jump: Jumping out. See you on the other side.
warlord: That's a big one. I like big ones.
Warlord's here. Finally, a real fight.

launch_mining: Undocking. Keeping an eye on the scopes.
launch_bounty: Moving out. I'll keep my distance until I'm sure.
on_site: On site. Scanning for trouble before I start.
loaded: Hold's full. Heading home the safe way.
delivered: Cargo's in. Glad to be home.
under_fire: I'm under fire! Need help out here!
repairs: Returning for repairs before it gets worse.
The damage report isn't pretty. Coming in.
jump: Entering the gate. Wish me luck.
warlord: That's a warlord's flagship. Keep your distance.
Warlord on scope. Nobody be a hero.
raid_alert: Raiders inbound. Everyone stay close to the station.

launch_bounty: A price on their head? Say no more.
on_site: On site. Let's see what this rock is worth.
loaded: Full hold. Heading home to get paid.
under_fire: Taking fire! This wasn't in the contract!
shields_down: Shields are gone. Repairs are going to cost me!
No shields. This is getting expensive.
fleeing: Not dying for this pay. I'm out!
kill: Got one. That's a bonus, right?
hunting: Target in range. Time to collect.
repairs: Coming in for repairs. Hope they're cheap.
jump: Jumping. Long trips pay more, I hope.
Through the gate. The meter's running.
warlord: A warlord. I hope someone's paying for this one.
Big target. Big bounty, I hope.
raid_alert: Raiders. Keep them away from my cargo.
Hostiles inbound. Who's paying for the defence?

launch_bounty: Okay, I'll take it. Don't rush me.
shields_down: Shields are gone. Great. Just great.
kill: Target down. Can I go home now?
hunting: There they are. Let's get this over with.
repairs: Coming in for repairs. And a coffee.
jump: Jumping. Wake me when we're there.
warlord: Oh no. That's a big one.
A warlord? Not my problem. Is it my problem?
